face.label: Hide a face
face.hint: An oval over the face, blurred hard. Add one box for each person.

plate.label: Hide a number plate
plate.hint: A rectangle over the plate, turned into large blocks. Tick This one moves for a car that drives across the picture.

black.label: Black box
black.hint: A solid black rectangle. Nothing shows through it, so this hides the most.

area.label: Blur an area
area.hint: A softer blur over any part of the picture, such as a screen, a letter or a name tag.
